title: Descent of normalized finite shift comparisons
statement: For a stage-system morphism F between the general rational coefficient stages on arbitrary schemes V and W [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], suppose c assigns each finite functor an integer CommShift structure and every beta commutes with these shifts. There is an integer CommShift structure on the actual pair functor F.functor for which every canonical inclusion comparison F.ιCompFunctorIso E commutes with shifts, using c E on the finite functor. This asserts no additivity, exactness, adjunction, or localization conclusion.

theorem sfLocalizationShiftDescent {V W : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : (stageSystem l Ω V).Morphism (stageSystem l Ω W))
    (c : ∀ E, (F.Φ E).CommShift ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
      let := c E
      let := c L
      NatTrans.CommShift (F.β h).hom ℤ) :
    ∃ s : F.functor.CommShift ℤ,
      letI := s
      ∀ E : Index l Ω,
        let := c E
        NatTrans.CommShift (F.ιCompFunctorIso E).hom ℤ
